tiers.formalized: machine-checked proof of the claim (Lean-class); no artifact holds this tier yet
tiers.oracle-tested: numbers produced under an enforced oracle gate (bitwise/fixed-point/monotonicity) — a failing gate would have blocked the artifact
tiers.measured: honest measurement without an oracle gate (probe runs, AUROC tables, wall-clock benchmarks)
tiers.unverified: plans, drafts, or numbers not yet reproduced
